spots.name: RRS Discovery
spots.summary: RRS Discovery is a barque-rigged auxiliary steamship built in Dundee, Scotland, for Antarctic research. Launched in 1901, she was the last traditional wooden three-masted ship to be built in the United Kingdom.

spots.name: HMS Unicorn

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: HMS Unicorn is a surviving sailing frigate of the successful Leda class, although the original design had been modified by the time that the Unicorn was built, to incorporate a circular stern and "small-timber" system of construction.

spots.name: V&A Dundee
spots.summary: V&A Dundee is a design museum in Dundee, Scotland, which opened on 15 September 2018. The V&A Dundee is the first design museum in Scotland and the first Victoria and Albert museum outside London.

spots.name: Dundee Law
spots.summary: Dundee Law is a hill in the centre of Dundee, Scotland, and is the highest point in the city. The Law is what remains of a volcanic sill, which is the result of volcanic activity around 400 million years ago. With a large war memorial at its summit, it is the most prominent feature on the local skyline.

spots.name: Broughty Castle

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Broughty Castle is a historic castle on the banks of the River Tay in Broughty Ferry, Dundee, Scotland. It was completed around 1495, although the site was earlier fortified in 1454, when George Douglas, 4th Earl of Angus, received permission to build on the site.

spots.name: The McManus
spots.summary: The McManus: Dundee's Art Gallery and Museum is a Gothic Revival-style building, located in the centre of Dundee, Scotland. The building houses a museum and art gallery with a collection of fine and decorative art as well as a natural history collection. It is protected as a Category A listed building.

spots.name: St Paul's Cathedral, Dundee

hours.note: Closed Sat

spots.summary: St. Paul's Cathedral is an Anglican cathedral in the city of Dundee, Scotland. It is the cathedral and administrative centre of the Diocese of Brechin in the Scottish Episcopal Church.

spots.name: High School of Dundee
spots.summary: The High School of Dundee is a private, co-educational, day school in Dundee, Scotland, which provides nursery, primary and secondary education to just over one thousand pupils. Its foundation has been dated to 1239, and it is the only private school in Dundee.

spots.name: The Howff
spots.summary: The Howff is a burial ground in the city of Dundee, Scotland. Established in 1564, it has one of the most important collections of tombstones in Scotland, and is protected as a category A listed building.

spots.name: St Andrew's Cathedral, Dundee
spots.summary: The Cathedral Church of St Andrew is a Catholic cathedral in the West End of the city of Dundee, Scotland. The cathedral is the seat of the Bishop of Dunkeld and mother church of the Diocese of Dunkeld within the Province of St Andrews and Edinburgh. The bishop, since may 2024, is Andrew McKenzie.

spots.name: Claypotts Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Claypotts Castle is a late medieval castle in the suburban West Ferry area of Dundee, Scotland. It is one of the best-preserved examples of a 16th-century Z-plan tower house in Scotland. Now surrounded by modern housing, the castle is maintained as an Ancient Monument by Historic Environment Scotland.

spots.name: Caird Hall
spots.summary: The Caird Hall is a concert auditorium located in Dundee, Scotland. It is a Category A listed building.

spots.name: Dundee Parish Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Dundee Parish Church is located in the east section of Dundee's "City Churches", the other being occupied by the Steeple Church. Both are congregations in the Church of Scotland, although with differing styles of worship.

spots.name: Dundee Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Dundee Castle was a castle in Dundee, Scotland, that Robert the Bruce destroyed in 1313.

spots.name: Steeple Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Steeple Church occupies the western part of the historic "City Churches" building in Dundee, Scotland. It is a congregation of the Church of Scotland.

spots.name: Dudhope Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Dudhope Castle is an extended late medieval tower house located on the southern face of Dundee Law in Dundee, Scotland.

spots.name: Dundee Repertory Theatre
spots.summary: Dundee Repertory Theatre, better known simply as the Dundee Rep, is a theatre and arts company in Dundee, Scotland.

names.ja: ダンディー・レップシアター

spots.name: Mains Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Mains Castle is a 16th-century castle in Dundee, Scotland. The castle consists of several buildings surrounding a courtyard, although several of the original western buildings no longer exist. The northern and eastern buildings are where the family would have lived, with the servants occupying the southern quarters.

spots.name: Dundee City Chambers
spots.summary: Dundee City Chambers is a municipal facility in City Square, Dundee, Scotland. The city chambers, which is headquarters of Dundee City Council, is a Category B listed building.

spots.name: Gardyne's Land, Dundee
spots.summary: Gardyne's Land is a complex of five historic buildings on the High Street, Dundee, Scotland. They are the oldest domestic buildings in that city.

spots.name: Dundee International Submarine Memorial
spots.summary: Dundee International Submarine Memorial commemorates the 296 sailors and commandos lost on operations from the submarine base at Dundee in Scotland, HMS Ambrose, during World War II.

spots.name: Verdant Works
spots.summary: Verdant Works, also known as Scotland's Jute Museum, is a former jute mill in the Blackness area of Dundee, Scotland. It was purchased in 1991 by the Dundee Heritage Trust.

spots.name: Tannadice Park
spots.summary: Tannadice Park, officially known as The CalForth Construction Arena for sponsorship reasons, is a football stadium in Dundee, Scotland. It is the home ground of Dundee United, who have played at Tannadice since the club was founded as Dundee Hibernian in 1909.

spots.name: Broughty Ferry Lifeboat Station
spots.summary: Broughty Ferry Lifeboat Station is located at the bottom of Fort Street, in the town of Broughty Ferry, a suburb of Dundee on the north shore of the River Tay estuary, in the historic county of Angus, Scotland.

spots.name: Dundee Central Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Dundee Central Mosque is a Sunni Deobandi mosque, located on the junction of Brown and Miln streets, to the west of the city centre of Dundee, Scotland, in the United Kingdom. Completed in 1995, the mosque replaced an earlier mosque, completed in 1969, located on South Erskine Street.

spots.name: Dundee Science Centre

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri

spots.summary: Dundee Science Centre is a science centre located in Dundee, Scotland, and a part of the Scottish Science Centres Network. It is a registered charity under Scottish law. It is funded by the public and donations from local corporate sponsors.

spots.name: Dens Park
spots.summary: Dens Park is a football stadium in Dundee, Scotland, which is the home of Scottish Premiership club Dundee F.C. and has a capacity of 11,775. Tannadice Park, the home of rivals Dundee United, is just 200 yards away.

spots.name: D'Arcy Thompson Zoology Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Sun

spots.summary: The D'Arcy Thompson Zoology Museum is a museum of zoology at the University of Dundee in Scotland.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Tayport Castle, was a Z plan castle that was located near Tayport, Fife, Scotland. The castle was demolished in the 19th century and no remains above ground are visible.

spots.name: Dundee Sheriff Court
spots.summary: Dundee Sheriff Court is a judicial building on West Bell Street in Dundee in Scotland. The building, which operates as the main courthouse for the area, is a Category B listed building.
